comparisonPolicy.name: same-family-check-after-each-source-or-harness-repair-opportunity
comparisonPolicy.rule: Count a potential focused campaign after each distinct repair opportunity. Record bundled opportunities and actual campaigns separately. The counterfactual is a policy comparison, not observed human behavior or causal proof.
comparisonPolicy.fullSweepRule: A changed shared owner, omitted current family, or unexplained cross-family regression can reopen discovery. A local application or harness defect reopens its dependent cases.
comparisonPolicy.checkpoint: First family handoff or three coherent repair batches, whichever occurs first

eventLedger.rule: One append-only ledger. The original 13 records retain their bytes and order. Dated retrospective annotations reference those event IDs; plans and annotations carry no execution counts.
eventLedger.historicalTiming: Original occurrence times, source/runtime identities and pre-run predictions remain unspecified. recordedOn dates annotation work only.
eventLedger.causalStanding: triggeredBy names a retrospectively supported dependency or a prospective plan trigger. Link standing distinguishes that interpretation from measured causal attribution.
eventLedger.receivingEvidence: Wave 1/2 events record the parent's supplied observations dated 2026-10-03. occurredOn supplies the reported day; exact occurrence timestamps, source/runtime identities, manifest locators and pre-execution prediction times remain unspecified. Append order records this return without inventing within-day timestamps. One subsequent scope-addition event records the supplied HTML-change resume under the same v3 definition. Its embedded request annotation classifies additional requested work separately from defects; the preceding 35 entries remain unchanged.

units.family: A source-owned group of related tables and maintained projections with a shared visitor/acceptance contract. One family may contain several repair batches.
units.repairBatch: One named defect or contract scope with pinned input and definition, declared acceptance cases and one receiving review. A batch may span families when their owners or dependencies require a coherent repair.
units.completedRepairBatch: The declared acceptance cases and required gates have evidence at the pinned revision, findings have explicit dispositions, and the receiving human records acceptance.
units.campaign: One logical invocation over a frozen ordered case inventory. Launches, retries, case attempts, completions, reuse and ancillary journeys are separate counts.
units.checkpoint: First accepted family handoff or three accepted coherent repair batches, whichever occurs first. Three families is a separate future feasibility checkpoint; repeated widths and reruns retain their repair-cluster dependence.

observationDefinitions.boundary: The historical text-retention assertion retains its original scope. Fresh v3 material evidence separately covers exact Rung 05, prompt agreement, inspector visibility and lastAction.

observationDefinitions.disposition: Records with incomplete dependency closure become ineligible for reuse under the corrected identity. Preserve them as historical observations and earn fresh dependent evidence; an uncertain boundary broadens the fitting case set.
observationDefinitions.evidenceBoundary: Table closure and unchanged resume use the recorded table definition hash. Material checks retain their separately described assertions; their definition hashes were not supplied.

invalidationPolicy.reuse: Evaluate every row and preserve all applicable reasons. Union selected IDs in frozen requested order. Reuse requires exact matching identity, complete evidence and matching required artifacts for every retained case.
invalidationPolicy.authority: Known gates remain deterministic. Campaign lifecycle state is recorded separately from cumulative invalidation reasons.

handoffOutcomeContract.unit: One completed, independently ascertained window for one accepted family handoff.
handoffOutcomeContract.handoff: Record the accepted revision, family/repair cluster, evidence manifest, finding dispositions and human receiving review decision. Issue closure supplies coordination context; publication is required only when the receiving contract includes it.
handoffOutcomeContract.window: Before handoff, declare the window duration/end rule, severity threshold, ascertainment plan and independent reviewer. Start at actual acceptance; record the resulting start/end timestamps. Qualifying discoveries occur after start and through the declared end. Historical times remain unspecified.

severity.blocking: A defect affecting safety, accessibility, security/privacy, state integrity or the usability of a required visitor task that blocks acceptance.
severity.material: A defect in the accepted scope that changes the required behavior or evidence claim enough to require repair or revised acceptance.
severity.minor: An editorial or cosmetic issue that leaves the declared acceptance behavior intact; retain it as a finding outside this indicator.

handoffOutcomeContract.ascertainment: An independent reviewer covers the declared acceptance cases and linked reports through the window end, records completion and adjudicates each finding against the accepted revision and severity rule. Known unresolved pre-handoff findings belong to handoff disposition; defects introduced by later source changes belong to their own repair episode.
handoffOutcomeContract.censoring: A started window whose follow-up ends early or remains in progress is censored. Missing duration, severity or ascertainment data is unmeasured. Both states retain outcome=null; complete observed zero requires the full declared window and completed ascertainment.
handoffOutcomeContract.indicator: Y=1 when at least one adjudicated qualifying late defect occurs in a completed eligible window; Y=0 when that complete observation establishes zero qualifying defects. Several qualifying defects in one window contribute one Bernoulli outcome.
handoffOutcomeContract.separation: Pre-handoff application gaps, harness repairs, selected/reused cases and demonstration runs describe mechanisms. Prospective next-campaign selection has its own exact-case agreement outcome.

estimation.model: Beta-Bernoulli late-defect indicator per eligible completed handoff window

prior.standing: illustrative-and-uncalibrated; uniform on the selected probability parameter

estimation.updateRule: For f qualifying outcomes among n completed eligible windows: Beta(a+f,b+n-f). One eligible observation updates the prior. With n=0 the posterior equals the prior.

rateOrDiffusionFit.measurementRequirements: Measured eligible durations, transitions and an identified model; any fit has a separate receiving decision.

estimation.boundary: Update, precision, calibration and adoption are distinct decisions. This refinement records eligibility and the unchanged prior; it fits no new model.
